#### What's great

I have tried a lot of these AI based dictation applications, such as Wisprflow Fluid Voice, Eloquent, Dictation with Raycast and Handy, and at the moment, this is the application I like the most out of all of them: one because it's free, and also because it is very responsive with the accuracy and with the speed with which the text gets put onto the page.

#### What needs improvement

The app could do a slightly better job of helping you set up the keyboard shortcuts to make it work. It's a little bit unwieldly, but it does work.
